requirements.summary: Environment calls from user mode, MRET to the privilege in MPP, and machine-only instructions refused in user mode.
With MPRV set, loads and stores use the privilege in MPP; MRET to user mode clears MPRV.
Fetches, loads and stores that PMP denies are access faults; the PMP CSRs read back, take effect at the next instruction and keep locked entries.
Timer and software interrupts beside the external one, their priority, user mode ignoring MIE, nesting and vectored entry.
WFI waits for an enabled pending interrupt, retires before it is taken, and is illegal in user mode under TW.
